pages.contentHtml:
FAQ Accordion Section
1. What is Johovo? +

Johovo is a premium online store offering a wide range of cosmetic products including lip care, hair care, body care, and skincare items—delivered all over India

2. Do you offer delivery all over India? +

Yes, we provide delivery services to all locations across India

3. How long does delivery take? +

Delivery time depends on your location. It usually takes 2 to 3 days (minimum) and 2 to 5 days (maximum)

4. Is shipping free? +

No, within Tamil Nadu, a charge of Rs. 50 is charged and for other states, a charge of Rs. 80 is charged. If you purchase items above Rs. 999, you will get free shipping

5. Do you offer discounts or coupon codes? +

Yes, we occasionally run promotions and offer discount codes. Keep an eye on our website and social media for the latest deals

6. What payment methods are available? +

We accept UPI, bank transfer, debit card, credit card, and cash on delivery (COD)

7. How can I place an order? +

You can place your order by adding items to your cart, going to the checkout page, selecting a payment method, and completing the purchase

8. Where is my order? +

Your order will usually arrive within 2 to 4 days of ordering. If not, please wait another 3 days or contact us for assistance.

9. What is your return policy? +

To view our return policy, please visit the Return Policy Page. To view our Return Policy, click on the provided link.

10. What is your refund policy? +

You can find all refund-related information on the Refund Policy Page by clicking the link

11. Where can I find your delivery policy? +

For full delivery details, please visit the Delivery Policy Page and follow the link

12. How do I contact Johovo? +

You can contact us through

Email : support@johovo.in

Phone : +91 784573369

WhatsApp : +91 91765 13323

13. What are your support hours? +

Our customer support is available 12 hours a day, 7 days a week (12/7)

14. How do I join the affiliate program? +

To join our affiliate program, please read the instructions on the Affiliate Program Page and sign up from there.

15. What should I do if I receive a damaged or incorrect item? +

If you receive a damaged or incorrect item, contact us immediately. We'll assist you with a return, replacement, or refund as per our policy

pages.contentHtml:
Welcome to JOHOVO

At JOHOVO, we’re passionate about helping you achieve healthy, glowing skin, luscious locks, and soft, nourished lips and body. Our mission is to provide high-quality, herbal-based products that cater to your diverse beauty needs.

Our Story

JOHOVO was founded on the principle of harnessing the power of nature to create effective, gentle, and sustainable products. Our journey began with a deep understanding of the importance of natural ingredients and their ability to transform and nurture your skin, hair, lips, and body.

Our Mission

Our mission is to :

  1. Provide high-quality products : We’re committed to developing products that are not only effective but also safe, gentle, and free from harsh chemicals.
  2. Promote natural beauty : We believe in the power of nature and strive to create products that work in harmony with your body’s natural rhythms.
  3. Foster sustainability : We’re dedicated to reducing our environmental footprint and promoting eco-friendly practices throughout our operations.

Our Values

At JOHOVO, we value :

  1. Integrity : We’re committed to transparency and honesty in everything we do.
  2. Innovation : We’re constantly seeking new ways to improve our products and services.
  3. Sustainability : We’re dedicated to reducing our impact on the environment.
  4. Customer satisfaction : We’re passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences.

Our Products

Our product range includes :

  1. Skin care : Our skin care products are designed to nourish, protect, and rejuvenate your skin.
  2. Hair care : Our hair care products are formulated to promote healthy, strong, and luscious locks.
  3. Lip care : Our lip care products are designed to soften, nourish, and protect your lips.
  4. Body care : Our body care products are formulated to moisturize, soften, and rejuvenate your skin.

Join the JOHOVO Family

We’re excited to have you join our community! Follow us on social media to stay up-to-date with the latest news, tips, and product launches.

Thank you for choosing JOHOVO. We’re committed to helping you achieve your beauty goals and promoting a healthier, more sustainable approach to beauty.

At JOHOVO, we strive to provide high-quality herbal cosmetic products that meet our customers’ expectations. If you’re not satisfied with your purchase, we’re happy to accommodate returns and exchanges.

Return Eligibility

To be eligible for a return, please ensure that :

  • The product is returned within 7-10 business days from the date of delivery.
  • The product is in its original packaging with all tags and labels attached.
  • The product has not been used or tampered with.

Return Process

To initiate a return, please follow these steps :

  • Contact our customer support team via phone, email, or through our website.
  • Provide your order number, product details, and reason for return.
  • We’ll guide you through the return process and provide a return merchandise authorization (RMA) number.
  • Pack the product securely in its original packaging and ship it to our returns address.

Return Shipping

  • The customer is responsible for the cost of return shipping.
  • We recommend using a trackable shipping method to ensure the product is delivered safely.

Inspection and Refund

Upon receiving the returned product, we’ll inspect it to ensure it meets our return policy criteria. If the product is in its original condition, we’ll process a refund or exchange as per your preference.

Exchange

If you want to exchange the product for a different variant or product, please let us know, and we’ll guide you through the exchange process.

Non-Returnable Items

The following items are non-returnable :

  • Opened or used products : Products that have been opened, used, or tampered with are not eligible for return or exchange.
  • Customized products : Customized products, such as personalized packaging or special orders, are not eligible for return or exchange.

Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about our return policy, please don’t hesitate to contact us :

Phone : +91 7845873369

Email : support@johovo.in

Whatsapp : +91 91765 13323

We’re committed to providing excellent customer service and ensuring that you’re satisfied with your purchase.

At JOHOVO, we strive to deliver high-quality herbal cosmetic products to our customers in a timely and efficient manner. Here’s an overview of our delivery policy

Shipping Options

We offer the following shipping options 

Standard Shipping : This is our default shipping option, which takes 3-7 business days to deliver within India.

Express Shipping : This option takes 1-3 business days to deliver within India and is available at an additional cost.

International Shipping : We offer international shipping to [insert countries/regions], which takes 7-14 business days to deliver.

Delivery Timeframe

Business Days : Our delivery timeframe is Monday to Friday, excluding weekends and public holidays.

Delivery Estimates : We estimate delivery times based on business days, and these estimates are subject to change due to unforeseen circumstances.

Shipping Costs

Free Shipping : We offer free standard shipping on orders above Rs.999.

Shipping Charges : Shipping charges will be calculated based on the weight and dimensions of the package, as well as the shipping option chosen.

Tracking Your Order

Tracking Number : We’ll provide a tracking number for all orders, which can be used to track the status of your delivery.

Delivery Updates : We’ll send you updates on the status of your delivery, including shipping confirmation and delivery confirmation.

Delivery Issues

Undelivered Packages : If we encounter any issues with delivery, we’ll work with you to resolve the issue as quickly as possible.

Damaged Packages : If your package is damaged during shipping, please contact us, and we’ll assist you in resolving the issue.

Delivery Address

Accuracy : Please ensure that your delivery address is accurate and complete to avoid any delivery issues.

Changes : If you need to make any changes to your delivery address, please contact us as soon as possible.

Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about our delivery policy, please don’t hesitate to contact us

Phone : +91 7845873369

Email : support@johovo.in

Whatsapp : +91 91765 13323

We’re committed to delivering excellent customer service and ensuring that you receive your products in a timely and efficient manner.

pages.contentHtml:
At JOHOVO, we value your trust and are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information.

Information We Collect

We collect the following types of information

Personal Details : Name, email address, phone number, and shipping address.

Payment Information : Credit/debit card details, billing address, and payment method.

Browsing Data : IP address, browser type, operating system, and device information.

Order History : Details of products purchased, order dates, and order totals.

How We Use Your Information

We use your information to 

Process Orders : Fulfill and ship your orders, and handle returns and refunds.
Improve Our Services: Analyze customer behavior, preferences, and feedback to enhance our products and services.

Communicate with You : Respond to your queries, provide order updates, and send promotional emails (if you’ve opted-in).

Ensure Security : Prevent fraud, detect security threats, and protect our website and customers.

Sharing Your Information
We share your information with

Third-Party Service Providers : Payment gateways, shipping providers, and analytics tools.

Partners : We may partner with other businesses to offer joint promotions or services.

Legal Requirements : We may disclose your information if required by law or to comply with a court order.

Security Measures

We take the following security measures to protect your information

Encryption : We use SSL/TLS encryption to secure data transmission.

Secure Servers : Our servers are hosted in secure data centers with strict access controls.

Access Controls : Only authorized personnel have access to your personal information.

Your Rights

You have the following rights

Access : Request access to your personal information.

Correction : Request corrections to your personal information.

Deletion : Request deletion of your personal information.

Opt-Out : Opt-out of promotional emails or marketing communications.

Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies and tracking technologies to

Improve User Experience : Enhance website functionality and personalize your experience.

Analyze Performance : Track website performance and analytics.

Updates to This Policy

We may update this policy to reflect changes in our business or regulatory requirements. We’ll notify you of any significant changes.

Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about our customer privacy policy, please contact us

Email : johovo33@gmail.com
Phone : +91-7845873369

We’re committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your personal information is handled with care.
